_doc: Recorded alert incidents replayed by tests/alert-replay.test.mts (#10976). Each wording is one copy the pipeline saw: its source label, the classifier's label, the publisher timestamp, and when the digest first scored it (seenAt). title is null where the incident write-up did not record the headline. expected is what should happen; knownMiss names the issue that should make an expected alert pass, and the test fails once it does so the entry gets updated.

incidents.summary: ADNOC said one of its vessels was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, 11 crew injured and one missing. About 20 outlets reported it from 06:47 UTC; no realtime subscriber was alerted.

wordings.title: one crew member missing after attack on its vessel in Hormuz
wordings.label: high
